concept.inflammatory-breast-cancer.core-.learningObjective: Interpret target position and specimen contents after a benign breast core result and choose representative further tissue assessment rather than dismiss a persistent suspicious parenchymal lesion.
concept.inflammatory-breast-cancer.core-.versioningReason: Initial tissue confirmation changes to an actual benign-core/imaging-target discordance decision.

concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.high-risk-.displayName: Sequence treatment of recurrent ulcer bleeding
concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.high-risk-.learningObjective: Distinguish recurrent bleeding after initially successful endoscopy from failure of repeat hemostasis and select repeat endoscopy, angiographic or operative rescue from actual resuscitation/access findings.
concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.high-risk-.versioningReason: A high-risk-stigmata recognition rule changes to selecting an escalation sequence after a documented treatment course.

concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.endoscopic.displayName: Recognize failed repeat ulcer hemostasis and select rescue
concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.endoscopic.learningObjective: Use documented repeat-endoscopy failure and target access to choose angiographic versus further endoscopic or operative rescue for recurrent peptic-ulcer bleeding.
concept.peptic-ulcer-bleeding.endoscopic.versioningReason: Selection among initial endoscopic modalities changes to the escalation boundary after failed repeat therapy.

concept.colonic-lipoma.endoscopic-recogn.displayName: Distinguish clinical characterization from histologic confirmation
concept.colonic-lipoma.endoscopic-recogn.learningObjective: Use the EUS-defined lesion layer and the actual submitted tissue to document whether a clinically characterized fatty submucosal lesion has histologic confirmation, without equating that status with a need for another biopsy.
concept.colonic-lipoma.endoscopic-recogn.versioningReason: The scored task changes from selecting further tissue intervention to adjudicating two evidence-status claims. Preserve the older recognition and tissue-planning constructs and their histories; the passed no-follow-up companion is unchanged.

concept.achalasia.high-resolution-manome.displayName: Interpret provocative motility responses before further planning
concept.achalasia.high-resolution-manome.learningObjective: Distinguish post-rapid-swallow contractile reserve from liquid-load outflow findings using actual pressure responses, without converting a provocative finding into a complete motor diagnosis.
concept.achalasia.high-resolution-manome.versioningReason: The score changes from choosing a protocol extension to interpreting two acquired provocative responses. Retain v2 protocol-selection histories and exact passed companion versions.

concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.displayName: Interpret mapped partial specimens before melanoma planning
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.learningObjective: Integrate the specimen's location, represented tissue compartments and cut surface to retain valid local findings while limiting whole-lesion diagnosis or depth claims before completion pathology.
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.versioningReason: The score changes from selecting complete excision to adjudicating what a mapped partial specimen establishes for subsequent planning. Excision remains the shared requested procedure; retain the older procedural-selection construct and its histories.

concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.displayName: Integrate enhancement and compartment anatomy in biopsy planning
concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.learningObjective: Use matched precontrast/postcontrast findings and compartment relationships to select a viable proposed target and tract for the radiology planning report.
concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.versioningReason: The score changes from choosing MRI completion for field coverage to selecting a target/tract from actual MRI findings. Preserve v2 imaging-adequacy history and the exact passed later biopsy-planning version.

concept.inguinal-hernia.symptomatic-elec.displayName: Prioritize care when groin findings have competing symptom sources
concept.inguinal-hernia.symptomatic-elec.learningObjective: Integrate interval functional observations with a demonstrated reducible inguinal hernia and coexisting musculoskeletal findings to choose the current care priority.
concept.inguinal-hernia.symptomatic-elec.versioningReason: The scored decision now compares active care targets using interval functional evidence, rather than choosing referral timing from an explicitly assigned hernia symptom. Retain the prior repair/observation concept and histories without transfer.

concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.displayName: Select diagnostic extent after a locally in-situ partial specimen
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.learningObjective: Apply an adequately described local epidermal melanoma finding to the next primary-site procedure without extending that finding to an unrepresented raised residual component.
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.complete-d.versioningReason: The scored objective changes from a local/residual classification matrix to the extent and phase of the next primary-site procedure. Retain mapped-evidence v3 and the original procedural concept; do not transfer their review history.

concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.partial-de.displayName: Integrate partial depth records before a nodal-staging discussion
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.partial-de.learningObjective: Preserve demonstrated invasive depth across mapped partial specimens and decide whether that evidence already supports a sentinel-node staging discussion while primary assessment continues.
concept.pigmented-skin-lesion.partial-de.versioningReason: The score now integrates two specimen-depth records and applies an independently sourced nodal-discussion boundary; it is no longer only lower-bound report recognition. Retain mapped-partial-evidence and prior nodal-staging concepts without FSRS-history transfer.

concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.displayName: Check MRI acquisition comparability before biopsy targeting
concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.learningObjective: Recognize when different acquisition settings prevent an intrinsically bright mass region from being assessed for contrast-related signal change, and request the comparison needed before targeting.
concept.soft-tissue-mass.extremity-mri.v.versioningReason: The scored objective changes from target-plus-tract selection to MRI acquisition adequacy. This deliberately removes rehearsal of the frozen later method/tract task and retains the previous v3 construct for saved encounters and scheduling history.

concept.varicose-veins.axial-trunk-refer.learningObjective: Use duplex anatomy to identify the axial superficial-vein target for specialist intervention assessment.
concept.varicose-veins.axial-trunk-refer.versioningReason: The old objective chooses intervention referral versus conservative care from candidacy and preference. The replacement instead identifies a specific venous treatment target from duplex anatomy, so it requires a new scored-construct version. Preserve the old concept and FSRS history rather than relabelling this change as wording only.

concept.dcis.sentinel-node-mastectomy.v1.learningObjective: Apply the planned mastectomy setting to choose the timing and extent of axillary staging for sampled DCIS.
concept.dcis.sentinel-node-mastectomy.v1.versioningReason: Replace the disputed oncoplastic future-mapping exception with the separately sourced standard mastectomy setting. The old broad setting concept and original question remain available for frozen encounters; history is not silently transferred to this narrower scored construct.

concept.dcis.final-cavity-shave-plan.v1.learningObjective: Reconcile oriented main and additional cavity specimens, then apply the pure-DCIS margin rule to the final treatment decision.
concept.dcis.final-cavity-shave-plan.v1.versioningReason: The prior question requests more record review for a close edge. This decision uses completed, reconciled final margins to choose treatment; preserve the earlier scored construct and histories.

concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.displayName: Plan imaging after a changed postlaparoscopy course
concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.learningObjective: Interpret the postoperative course, then distinguish biliary leak detection from duct-anatomy localization in a stable CT-assessed record.
concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.versioningReason: A nerve-association question becomes a clinical imaging decision after postoperative reassessment. The new workup objective must not inherit the anatomy card history.

concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.displayName: Distinguish reflux assessment from DVT imaging
concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.learningObjective: Interpret a completed compression-only venous study, then select the diagnostic protocol needed for symptomatic superficial venous treatment assessment.
concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.versioningReason: This is diagnostic-protocol selection rather than matching a named axial vein to an intervention; preserve both earlier candidacy and target-selection constructs.

concept.hyperkalaemia.post-calcium-treat.learningObjective: Distinguish ECG stabilization from potassium correction and select the remaining treatment mechanism in a completed inpatient record.
concept.hyperkalaemia.post-calcium-treat.versioningReason: The original objective is community disposition; the replacement scores treatment-response interpretation after hospital admission. Keep their histories separate.

concept.head-neck.cyst-fluid-sample-asse.displayName: Act on an unrepresentative adult neck aspirate
concept.head-neck.cyst-fluid-sample-asse.learningObjective: Interpret a cyst-fluid specimen in a persistent adult neck lesion and request representative needle reassessment rather than presume benignity or jump to open surgery.
concept.head-neck.cyst-fluid-sample-asse.versioningReason: The prior card asks for the initial FNA route. The replacement scores adequacy and the next diagnostic strategy, so it receives a new construct version.

concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.displayName: Apply new decompensation findings to elective planning
concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.learningObjective: Interpret new fluid findings despite reassuring biochemical results and select optimization before a nonurgent operation.
concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.versioningReason: The prior item names an underestimated risk domain. This version scores an operative-timing consequence of a new clinical event; keep the risk-domain history separate.

concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.displayName: Select source imaging in a lymphangitic presentation
concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.learningObjective: Localize a distal source from the proximal lymphatic pattern, then choose imaging of an uncertain source swelling rather than the tender veins or draining nodes.
concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.versioningReason: Recognition of a syndrome becomes a source-assessment decision using an additional independently recorded soft-tissue-ultrasound claim. Preserve the recognition card.

concept.laparoscopy.pressure-cardiopulmo.learningObjective: Integrate controlled circulatory observations with ventilator-pressure observations to distinguish venous-return and respiratory-mechanics explanations.
concept.laparoscopy.pressure-cardiopulmo.versioningReason: The scored objective now includes a separate respiratory-mechanics interpretation, not the old two-phase venous sequence. Preserve the previous physiology histories.

concept.perioperative-dnr.recovery-endpo.displayName: Apply an agreed perioperative directive endpoint
concept.perioperative-dnr.recovery-endpo.learningObjective: Interpret a stipulated recovery state and apply the agreed endpoint for reinstating a baseline directive.
concept.perioperative-dnr.recovery-endpo.versioningReason: A definition of what DNR means becomes application of an agreed peri-anaesthetic modification and recovery criterion. The original scope-of-order construct remains available.

concept.gallstones.cholestatic-next-stud.displayName: Select further imaging from the unresolved biliary question
concept.gallstones.cholestatic-next-stud.learningObjective: Distinguish a ductal diagnostic question from ongoing gallbladder inflammation and choose noninvasive duct assessment before a therapeutic pathway.
concept.gallstones.cholestatic-next-stud.versioningReason: The keyed clinical decision changes from selected HIDA for suspected cholecystitis to MRCP for possible duct stone disease; a new concept version is required.

concept.osa.discordant-screen-documentat.learningObjective: Reconcile sleepiness and OSA-probability reports, then document and communicate risk without making a screening diagnosis.
concept.osa.discordant-screen-documentat.versioningReason: The prior task chooses a generic assessment method. This task scores interpretation and communication of completed named reports, with no cutoff calculation or diagnosis by questionnaire.

concept.laparoscopy.position-gas-integra.learningObjective: Use a reversible position change and a persistent arterial-gas pattern to distinguish two simultaneous laparoscopy physiology mechanisms.
concept.laparoscopy.position-gas-integra.versioningReason: The narrow early-filling direction question becomes integration of position-dependent return and a separate gas interpretation. This new construct is distinct from the pressure/compliance item and retains the old foundational version.

concept.dtc.cystic-node-repeat-sampling..displayName: Resolve a cystic node before thyroid surgery
concept.dtc.cystic-node-repeat-sampling..learningObjective: Reconcile suspicious nodal morphology with cyst-fluid cytology and select an appropriate ancillary sampling request before planning surgery.
concept.dtc.cystic-node-repeat-sampling..versioningReason: The prior question classifies the general contribution of ultrasound. The replacement scores specimen/imaging discordance and a specific node-assessment consequence, requiring a new concept version.

concept.palpable-mass.separate-benign-ta.displayName: Reconcile a benign biopsy with a different palpable lesion
concept.palpable-mass.separate-benign-ta.learningObjective: Match the sampled lesion to the clinical target before choosing further assessment for a concerning imaging-occult finding.
concept.palpable-mass.separate-benign-ta.versioningReason: The replacement adds lesion-identity/histology concordance rather than simply repeating the old imaging-negative biopsy rule. Preserve the earlier scored objective and history.

concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.displayName: Apply leak anatomy to postcholecystectomy treatment
concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.learningObjective: Interpret duct continuity and adequacy of drainage, then select a procedure for persistent minor leakage.
concept.postlaparoscopy.shoulder-pain-bi.versioningReason: The scored decision changes from selecting localization imaging to treating a demonstrated minor leak. Retain the imaging construct and all earlier anatomy versions.

concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.displayName: Select the scope of a recurrent venous reflux map
concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.learningObjective: Use recurrent anatomical distributions and an incomplete prior reflux record to specify the mapping needed before another intervention.
concept.varicose-veins.reflux-after-comp.versioningReason: The scored distinction is completeness of a recurrent reflux map rather than reflux versus a completed DVT compression protocol.

concept.hyperacute-rejection.archived-cr.displayName: Select an archived test for preformed donor reactivity
concept.hyperacute-rejection.archived-cr.learningObjective: Use sample collection time and cellular target to choose a retrospective test of a preimplantation immune mechanism.
concept.hyperacute-rejection.archived-cr.versioningReason: This task scores investigation design and temporal evidence, rather than naming the preformed-antibody mechanism from explicit immunoglobulin/complement stains.

concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.displayName: Recognize an urgent change during cirrhosis optimization
concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.learningObjective: Interpret new obstructive hernia findings and distinguish emergency assessment from the earlier elective optimization sequence.
concept.cirrhosis.new-fluid-elective-pla.versioningReason: The scored action changes from deferring a nonurgent repair for ascites control to urgent assessment of a new obstructive presentation. Preserve the elective-risk concept and histories.

concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.displayName: Interpret a focal collection within a lymphangitic presentation
concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.learningObjective: Distinguish a superficial collection from nearby veins on ultrasound and apply the source-control consequence despite a coexisting ascending inflammatory pattern.
concept.lymphangitis.distal-source-imagi.versioningReason: The scored choice changes from imaging a source to treating an imaged focal collection. Retain the source-imaging and syndrome-recognition constructs.

concept.osa.discordant-screen-documentat.displayName: Use discordant sleep reports in perioperative communication
concept.osa.discordant-screen-documentat.learningObjective: Distinguish sleepiness from apnoea-probability information and decide what should drive current anaesthetic risk communication without requiring diagnostic confirmation.
concept.osa.discordant-screen-documentat.versioningReason: The scored task changes from choosing a certainty label to an assessment/communication sequence; retain the documentation construct and original screening-method history.

concept.laparoscopy.position-gas-integra.displayName: Separate gas direction from demonstrated acidemia
concept.laparoscopy.position-gas-integra.learningObjective: Interpret a controlled positional filling response and distinguish an acidifying gas change from an acidemic state using laboratory intervals.
concept.laparoscopy.position-gas-integra.versioningReason: The prior gas objective wrongly asserted acidemia from relative changes. This version instead scores recognition that a fall toward the reference interval is not demonstrated acidemia; retain the original histories and record the corrected construct explicitly.

concept.dtc.cystic-node-repeat-sampling..learningObjective: Use specimen adequacy and an intact-thyroid needle path to interpret discordant node results before selecting lateral-neck surgery or surveillance.
concept.dtc.cystic-node-repeat-sampling..versioningReason: The previous objective selects a familiar washout adjunct. The replacement scores interpretation of completed discordant results and their effect on a neck-operation decision.

concept.inguinal-hernia.direct-operative.learningObjective: Locate a medial groin defect in the posterior inguinal wall using its relationship to the inferior epigastric vessels.
concept.inguinal-hernia.direct-operative.novelty: Retains the unadmitted direct-defect identity; the active vessel-relationship objective concerns an indirect defect.

concept.postoperative-ascites.cross-sect.learningObjective: Choose broad contrast-enhanced abdominal and pelvic CT for stable progressive nonlocalized postoperative symptoms before labeling a fluid complication.
concept.postoperative-ascites.cross-sect.novelty: Adds the unadmitted broad postoperative evaluation objective rather than a second interpretation of an established transition point.

concept.chylous-ascites.fluid-confirmati.learningObjective: Use sampled-fluid triglycerides and directed fluid analysis to distinguish chylous ascites from other postoperative fluid processes.
concept.chylous-ascites.fluid-confirmati.novelty: Adds the unadmitted fluid-composition objective; duct localization and CT appearance do not answer it.

concept.postoperative-chylous-ascites.in.learningObjective: Choose a long-chain-fat-restricted, medium-chain-triglyceride-enriched nutritional strategy within hospital management of a symptomatic postoperative lymphatic leak.
concept.postoperative-chylous-ascites.in.novelty: Retains the unadmitted leak-specific nutritional construct, distinct from selecting an initial nutrition route for a functioning gut.

concept.postoperative-ileus.parenteral-n.learningObjective: Choose parenteral support when severe prolonged postoperative ileus prevents adequate oral or enteral nutrition after obstruction and other causes have been assessed.
concept.postoperative-ileus.parenteral-n.novelty: Adds the unadmitted prolonged-ileus exception rather than recoding the active initial enteral-route objective.

concept.ventral-hernia.controlled-entero.learningObjective: Choose the supported mesh material when a selected single-stage ventral repair proceeds after securely repaired enterotomy with adequate source control and minimal contamination.
concept.ventral-hernia.controlled-entero.novelty: Adds an unadmitted material-selection objective; the active construct decides fascial closure rather than implant material in controlled contamination.

concept.meckel-diverticulum.resection-ex.learningObjective: Choose diverticulectomy versus bowel-inclusive resection from disease at the diverticular base and adjacent ileum rather than an isolated width.
concept.meckel-diverticulum.resection-ex.novelty: Adds the unadmitted operative-extent construct; recognition of an obstructed patient is a different decision.

concept.n1.celiac-iga-deficient-serology.displayName: Celiac serology when IgA is deficient
concept.n1.celiac-iga-deficient-serology.learningObjective: Select an IgG-based celiac serologic pathway when IgA deficiency makes a negative IgA result uninterpretable.
concept.n1.celiac-iga-deficient-serology.novelty: The active objective uses adequate-IgA tTG testing; this new construct selects the replacement test class after demonstrated IgA deficiency.

concept.n1.celiac-restricted-diet-test-i.learningObjective: Recognize that negative serology or biopsy after gluten avoidance cannot settle the original celiac question and arrange a supervised diagnostic reassessment.
concept.n1.celiac-restricted-diet-test-i.novelty: Tests interpretation of a changed exposure and selection of a reassessment plan, rather than the initial test or confirmation step under valid exposure.

concept.n1.celiac-hla-positive-boundary.learningObjective: Distinguish HLA susceptibility from active celiac disease when deciding whether a positive genotype ends diagnostic evaluation.
concept.n1.celiac-hla-positive-boundary.novelty: Adds the interpretation of an incidental susceptibility result; the active objective starts from compatible positive disease serology.

concept.n1.hcc-portal-hypertension-refer.displayName: HCC tumor burden versus liver resection suitability
concept.n1.hcc-portal-hypertension-refer.learningObjective: Distinguish transplant tumor-burden eligibility from a favorable liver-resection profile when portal hypertension and decompensation are present.
concept.n1.hcc-portal-hypertension-refer.novelty: The existing combined favorable-profile case selects resection; this construct resolves a clinically different discordance between small tumor burden and poor liver reserve.

concept.n1.gastric-emptying-structural-p.learningObjective: Recognize when an unresolved mechanical outlet finding prevents attributing retained gastric contents to a motility disorder.
concept.n1.gastric-emptying-structural-p.novelty: The active objective assumes obstruction is excluded; this construct decides whether that prerequisite is actually satisfied.

concept.n1.post-ileus-nutrition-route-re.learningObjective: Reassess the indication for parenteral nutrition when oral and enteral delivery become adequate after prolonged ileus.
concept.n1.post-ileus-nutrition-route-re.novelty: The active objective chooses an initial route; this construct withdraws a previously justified parenteral route after its indication changes.

concept.n1.gallbladder-muscle-invasion-r.learningObjective: Recognize muscular invasion as outside the completely resected T1a observation pathway and obtain hepatobiliary surgical review.
concept.n1.gallbladder-muscle-invasion-r.novelty: The active objective permits completed T1a excision; this new referral construct concerns documented muscular invasion and does not prescribe an unverified extended operation.

concept.n1.gastric-adjacent-organ-resect.learningObjective: Distinguish a routine prophylactic organ removal from specialist assessment of direct adjacent-organ invasion during gastric cancer resection planning.
concept.n1.gastric-adjacent-organ-resect.novelty: The active objective concerns preservation without invasion; this construct determines whether documented direct invasion changes the operative question without asserting automatic resectability.

concept.breast-imaging.suspicious-mass-m.learningObjective: Integrate a mass's shape and margin rather than density when deciding which mammographic finding needs diagnostic tissue assessment.
concept.breast-imaging.suspicious-mass-m.novelty: Preserves the existing unadmitted morphology identity; the active core-biopsy objective starts after a suspicious target is identified.

concept.breast-imaging.suspicious-calcif.learningObjective: Interpret calcification morphology together with distribution to identify a concerning breast imaging target.
concept.breast-imaging.suspicious-calcif.novelty: Adds the unadmitted calcification interpretation objective; it does not create a second mass-biopsy identity.

concept.breast-mass.age-30-to-39.initial.displayName: Palpable breast mass in the thirties
concept.breast-mass.age-30-to-39.initial.learningObjective: Choose a supported diagnostic mammography or tomosynthesis and targeted-ultrasound pathway for a new palpable mass in an adult aged 30–39.
concept.breast-mass.age-30-to-39.initial.novelty: Retains the previously authored 30–39 identity, which is absent from the active catalog; this is a different age-specific imaging pathway.

concept.phyllodes.benign-complete-excisi.learningObjective: Apply complete excision without a mandated fixed-width margin to a benign phyllodes operative plan.
concept.phyllodes.benign-complete-excisi.novelty: Adds the unadmitted benign phyllodes surgical target; it is distinct from observation of concordant fibroadenoma.

concept.phyllodes.benign-positive-margin.learningObjective: Distinguish an isolated positive benign-phyllodes margin from evidence that residual tumor remains when discussing repeat surgery.
concept.phyllodes.benign-positive-margin.novelty: The existing unadmitted benign-phyllodes identity uses a disease-specific margin rule rather than importing a DCIS rule.

concept.phyllodes.borderline-close-margi.learningObjective: Apply the verified close-margin counseling categories after borderline phyllodes excision.
concept.phyllodes.borderline-close-margi.novelty: Adds an unadmitted disease-specific re-excision objective; DCIS margin adequacy does not answer it.

concept.phyllodes.malignant-close-margin.learningObjective: Apply the verified malignant-phyllodes close-margin recommendation while preserving breast-conserving options.
concept.phyllodes.malignant-close-margin.novelty: Preserves the unadmitted malignant-phyllodes close-margin identity rather than changing a DCIS construct.

concept.phyllodes.no-routine-axillary-st.learningObjective: Avoid routine sentinel-node or axillary staging for phyllodes when the axilla is nonsuspicious.
concept.phyllodes.no-routine-axillary-st.novelty: Adds the unadmitted phyllodes axillary objective; it deliberately contrasts a different rule from epithelial breast cancer/DCIS surgery.

concept.phyllodes.suspicious-node-biopsy.learningObjective: Obtain image-guided needle tissue from a suspicious axillary node despite phyllodes' uncommon nodal spread.
concept.phyllodes.suspicious-node-biopsy.novelty: Preserves the unadmitted suspicious-node exception, which is not an additional primary-breast-mass biopsy construct.

concept.phyllodes.borderline-margin-targ.learningObjective: Use the recorded 5-mm borderline-phyllodes counseling target when selecting among feasible breast-conserving excision plans.
concept.phyllodes.borderline-margin-targ.novelty: Preserves an unadmitted initial-planning identity, separate from a returned close-margin result.

concept.phyllodes.malignant-margin-targe.learningObjective: Use the recorded 10-mm malignant-phyllodes counseling target when planning complete excision.
concept.phyllodes.malignant-margin-targe.novelty: Preserves the unadmitted malignant-phyllodes initial-planning identity rather than creating a second close-margin result task.

concept.phyllodes.hematogenous-spread-pa.learningObjective: Interpret a distant-organ pattern after malignant phyllodes without assuming axillary negativity excludes metastatic disease.
concept.phyllodes.hematogenous-spread-pa.novelty: Adds an unadmitted disease-specific spread objective; axillary staging and general stage-versus-grade do not assess this route inference.

concept.n1.aldosterone-overt-phenotype-c.learningObjective: Apply the recorded overt-phenotype exception to additional aldosterone suppression testing before surgical localization.
concept.n1.aldosterone-overt-phenotype-c.novelty: Tests the intervening decision about whether suppression confirmation adds value, rather than obtaining the screening ratio or choosing a side for surgery.

concept.n1.time-dependent-inhibitor-fact.displayName: Factor assessment after an inhibitory mixing pattern
concept.n1.time-dependent-inhibitor-fact.learningObjective: Choose factor-specific investigation rather than procedural clearance or a final diagnosis from a time-dependent mixing result.
concept.n1.time-dependent-inhibitor-fact.novelty: The active construct interprets correction; this construct selects the subsequent factor investigation and preserves the mixing study's diagnostic limit.

concept.n1.lymphedema-new-tempo-venous-a.learningObjective: Investigate an acute postoperative change in a chronically swollen limb before attributing it to established lymphedema.
concept.n1.lymphedema-new-tempo-venous-a.novelty: Tests a change-of-tempo diagnostic override after a known chronic diagnosis, rather than first recognition of either chronic swelling or an uncomplicated postoperative DVT presentation.

concept.n1.graves-symptom-versus-hormone.learningObjective: Distinguish beta-blocker symptom improvement from disease-directed reduction of thyroid-hormone production when reviewing a Graves regimen.
concept.n1.graves-symptom-versus-hormone.novelty: The active objective compares long-term treatment choices; this one interprets a medication response without mistaking heart-rate relief for hormone-production control.

concept.n1.provoked-dvt-filter-versus-an.displayName: IVC filter versus anticoagulation for a provoked DVT
concept.n1.provoked-dvt-filter-versus-an.learningObjective: Avoid routine IVC-filter placement for a first uncomplicated postoperative proximal DVT when therapeutic anticoagulation is possible.
concept.n1.provoked-dvt-filter-versus-an.novelty: The active objective selects treatment duration; this new construct decides whether a mechanical filter should replace an otherwise usable anticoagulation pathway.

concept.n1.oxygen-saturation-missing-hem.learningObjective: Choose direct hemoglobin assessment when a normal pulse-oximeter result is being used to dismiss possible anemia.
concept.n1.oxygen-saturation-missing-hem.novelty: The active construct explains the content mechanism after anemia is supplied; this construct selects the missing measurement when anemia has not been assessed.

concept.n1.neck-mass-core-after-inadequa.displayName: Tissue sampling after inadequate neck FNA
concept.n1.neck-mass-core-after-inadequa.learningObjective: Choose selected core needle sampling when repeated FNA does not supply the tissue and ancillary material required to classify an adult neck mass.
concept.n1.neck-mass-core-after-inadequa.novelty: The active constructs select first FNA or assess a cystic-fluid sampling mismatch. This solid-node construct escalates the sampling method after repeated representative FNA remains insufficient for classification.

concept.n1.perioperative-respiratory-aci.learningObjective: Interpret a qualitative CO2, pH and bicarbonate trajectory as a respiratory acid-base process rather than inventing a new fixed-acid cause.
concept.n1.perioperative-respiratory-aci.novelty: The active objectives select a blood gas or explain CO2 absorption; this construct classifies the recorded acid-base trajectory using all three measurements.

concept.n1.burn-evolving-hand-depth-reas.learningObjective: Recognize evolving burn depth from serial raw findings and obtain burn-center consultation for a now-deep hand injury.
concept.n1.burn-evolving-hand-depth-reas.novelty: Adds a longitudinal reassessment construct rather than a second first-visit depth label; less pain must not be read automatically as healing.

concept.trauma-vka.concurrent-iv-vitamin.displayName: Paired treatments for urgent VKA reversal
concept.trauma-vka.concurrent-iv-vitamin.learningObjective: Recognize intravenous vitamin K as the paired adjunct to rapid factor replacement for emergency VKA reversal.
concept.trauma-vka.concurrent-iv-vitamin.novelty: Retains the unadmitted emergency-reversal adjunct identity; routine elective warfarin interruption is a separate decision.

concept.trauma-vka.four-factor-pcc-selec.learningObjective: Select four-factor PCC for rapid factor replacement in the recorded major-bleeding VKA emergency scope.
concept.trauma-vka.four-factor-pcc-selec.novelty: Adds the unadmitted emergency product-selection identity without changing elective interruption or bridging history.

concept.severe-burn.early-enteral-nutrit.displayName: Early nutrition after an extensive burn
concept.severe-burn.early-enteral-nutrit.learningObjective: Choose early enteral nutrition after adequate burn resuscitation when the gastrointestinal tract is usable.
concept.severe-burn.early-enteral-nutrit.novelty: Retains the unadmitted major-burn timing-and-route construct rather than recoding a general elective nutrition decision.

concept.thoracic-trauma.right-thoracotom.learningObjective: Choose right thoracic exposure for the recorded stable planned repair of proximal or middle intrathoracic esophageal injury and distinguish resuscitative access.
concept.thoracic-trauma.right-thoracotom.novelty: Retains an unadmitted operative-exposure identity; active thoracic trauma content evaluates cardiac injury rather than operative access.

concept.n2.sglt2-postoperative-restart.displayName: Postoperative SGLT2 restart after a fasting course
concept.n2.sglt2-postoperative-restart.learningObjective: Use present clinical stability and oral intake to determine postoperative SGLT2 resumption rather than carry forward a preoperative interval as an automatic restart clock.
concept.n2.sglt2-postoperative-restart.novelty: The existing objective selects the preoperative interruption interval; this decision assesses whether the postoperative restart conditions have actually returned.

concept.n2.naloxone-response-recurrence.learningObjective: Choose continued monitored respiratory care after an opioid-reversal response rather than infer durable recovery from the first improvement.
concept.n2.naloxone-response-recurrence.novelty: Tests the durability of an opioid-reversal response and its monitoring consequence, rather than receptor antagonism or arranging an escort after routine sedation.

concept.n2.oxygenation-versus-ventilatio.displayName: Ventilation despite a reassuring saturation display
concept.n2.oxygenation-versus-ventilatio.learningObjective: Select assessment of ventilation when sedation-associated respiratory depression is obscured by a reassuring oxygen-saturation display.
concept.n2.oxygenation-versus-ventilatio.novelty: Selects the missing respiratory measurement, distinct from choosing a reversal agent or measuring hemoglobin-dependent oxygen content.

concept.n2.sugammadex-recovery-endpoints.displayName: Motor reversal versus full anesthetic recovery
concept.n2.sugammadex-recovery-endpoints.learningObjective: Keep hypnotic and opioid recovery assessment separate after documented reversal of rocuronium blockade.
concept.n2.sugammadex-recovery-endpoints.novelty: Tests what a successful motor-block reversal does not establish about other anesthetic effects, rather than blocker identity or the method of measuring motor recovery.

concept.n2.ventilator-elastic-versus-res.learningObjective: Distinguish increased elastic pressure requirements from isolated airway resistance using controlled peak and plateau pressure comparisons.
concept.n2.ventilator-elastic-versus-res.novelty: Tests the controlled pressure-gradient inference itself, without assuming pneumoperitoneum caused it or combining it with venous-return interpretation.

concept.n2.refeeding-baseline-phosphate-.learningObjective: Distinguish pre-existing phosphate depletion from evidence of a feeding-associated change without dismissing the need for a monitored restart.
concept.n2.refeeding-baseline-phosphate-.novelty: Tests causal attribution from pre-exposure sampling, rather than explaining a post-feeding shift or selecting planned thiamine.

concept.n2.burn-feeding-perfusion-prereq.displayName: Perfusion before an early burn-feeding pathway
concept.n2.burn-feeding-perfusion-prereq.learningObjective: Withhold automatic application of the early-enteral burn pathway while shock and resuscitation remain unresolved.
concept.n2.burn-feeding-perfusion-prereq.novelty: Tests a competing immediate resuscitation priority that lies outside N1's adequately resuscitated early-feeding scenario, rather than its timing or route choice.

concept.n2.parenteral-response-versus-bo.displayName: Nutrition delivery versus recovery of intestinal function
concept.n2.parenteral-response-versus-bo.learningObjective: Do not infer restored gastrointestinal function from nutritional improvement during parenteral support.
concept.n2.parenteral-response-versus-bo.novelty: Tests whether a nutrition endpoint demonstrates motility recovery; N1 tests starting support or changing route after recovery is actually documented.

concept.n2.dialysis-isocaloric-protein-a.learningObjective: Meet the hospitalized conventional-dialysis protein target while preserving an independently assessed energy goal.
concept.n2.dialysis-isocaloric-protein-a.novelty: Tests a crossed prescription decision: correcting protein delivery must not automatically increase already adequate energy delivery. Separate prior objectives address the target or overfeeding in isolation.

concept.n2.vitamin-c-indication-boundary.displayName: A collagen cofactor is not universal postoperative therapy
concept.n2.vitamin-c-indication-boundary.learningObjective: Distinguish an established nutrient requirement from evidence that every adequately nourished postoperative patient needs high-dose supplementation.
concept.n2.vitamin-c-indication-boundary.novelty: Tests the therapeutic inference from a biochemical fact, rather than naming the collagen cofactor or diagnosing a nutritional risk.

concept.n2.vte-prophylaxis-to-treatment.displayName: A new DVT changes anticoagulation purpose
concept.n2.vte-prophylaxis-to-treatment.learningObjective: Distinguish prophylactic anticoagulation from treatment of a newly confirmed postoperative proximal DVT.
concept.n2.vte-prophylaxis-to-treatment.novelty: Tests the change in treatment intensity/purpose after an event despite prophylaxis, rather than duration of treatment or the filter-versus-anticoagulation decision.

concept.n2.af-bridging-versus-surgical-p.displayName: Heparin bridging and VTE prophylaxis are separate
concept.n2.af-bridging-versus-surgical-p.learningObjective: Keep the decision against routine therapeutic AF bridging separate from indicated postoperative surgical VTE prophylaxis.
concept.n2.af-bridging-versus-surgical-p.novelty: Tests two different indications for anticoagulation in the same plan, rather than treating no routine bridging as a prohibition on postoperative prophylaxis.

concept.n2.factor-assays-without-mixing-.displayName: Factor assays need not wait for a mixing-screen gate
concept.n2.factor-assays-without-mixing-.learningObjective: Arrange appropriate factor-specific assessment without using a mixing study as a mandatory serial gate when factor assays can proceed in parallel.
concept.n2.factor-assays-without-mixing-.novelty: The prior workup objective is explicitly scoped to unavailable immediate FVIII testing; N1 follows a returned mixing result. This decision prevents a serial screening delay at the initial specialist evaluation.

concept.n2.prophylaxis-versus-ssi-source.displayName: Purulence changes the purpose of wound care
concept.n2.prophylaxis-versus-ssi-source.learningObjective: Respond to a new localized purulent superficial incisional infection with source control rather than extend prophylactic antibiotics as its substitute.
concept.n2.prophylaxis-versus-ssi-source.novelty: Tests the transition from prevention to treatment when a postoperative finding changes, rather than routine prophylaxis duration or recognition of a stand-alone wound infection.

concept.n2.serial-gcs-verbal-interferenc.displayName: Comparing GCS observations with changed testability
concept.n2.serial-gcs-verbal-interferenc.learningObjective: Do not infer neurological deterioration from serial GCS totals when a new airway interference makes the verbal component untestable.
concept.n2.serial-gcs-verbal-interferenc.novelty: Tests whether serial observations are comparable, rather than assigning the individual component scores or documenting a single untestable component.

concept.n2.dnr-versus-active-source-cont.displayName: A DNR order and treatment before arrest
concept.n2.dnr-versus-active-source-cont.learningObjective: Keep an agreed limitation on arrest resuscitation separate from desired treatment of an active surgical problem.
concept.n2.dnr-versus-active-source-cont.novelty: Tests the scope of a resuscitation directive in a current source-control decision, rather than required perioperative reconsideration or whether a patient has decision-making capacity.

concept.n2.pancreatic-cyst-predates-panc.displayName: A pancreatic cyst that predates pancreatitis
concept.n2.pancreatic-cyst-predates-panc.learningObjective: Reassess the premise of inflammatory-collection drainage when prior imaging shows the pancreatic cyst existed before the pancreatitis episode.
concept.n2.pancreatic-cyst-predates-panc.novelty: Tests the origin assumed by the proposed procedure, rather than classifying a known post-pancreatitis collection or selecting its drainage route.

concept.n2.marginal-ulcer-obstructive-es.displayName: A changed course during marginal-ulcer treatment
concept.n2.marginal-ulcer-obstructive-es.learningObjective: Escalate beyond an uncomplicated marginal-ulcer medication pathway when progressive obstructive findings appear despite treatment.
concept.n2.marginal-ulcer-obstructive-es.novelty: Tests the exit from an initial uncomplicated pathway after changed findings, rather than selecting acid suppression and contributor control at diagnosis.

concept.n2.ulcer-posthemostasis-acid-sup.learningObjective: Retain indicated PPI treatment after successful high-risk ulcer hemostasis rather than equate immediate bleeding control with completion of ulcer-directed therapy.
concept.n2.ulcer-posthemostasis-acid-sup.novelty: Tests the remaining pharmacologic component after successful endoscopic hemostasis, rather than the endoscopic modality or rescue sequence for recurrent bleeding.

concept.n2.bile-leak-duct-continuity-bou.displayName: Duct continuity before a minor-leak stent pathway
concept.n2.bile-leak-duct-continuity-bou.learningObjective: Recognize when demonstrated bile-duct discontinuity prevents applying the preserved-continuity minor-leak ERCP pathway without HPB reassessment.
concept.n2.bile-leak-duct-continuity-bou.novelty: Tests the treatment pathway's continuity prerequisite after it has been assessed, rather than choosing the localization study or treating a confirmed minor leak with continuity preserved.

concept.n2.gastric-wall-mass-specimen-pr.displayName: A mucosal specimen does not classify an unsampled wall mass
concept.n2.gastric-wall-mass-specimen-pr.learningObjective: Assess whether the submitted gastric specimen represents the wall lesion before using it to clear or initiate targeted tumor treatment.
concept.n2.gastric-wall-mass-specimen-pr.novelty: Tests prior specimen provenance and its evidentiary limit, rather than simply choosing initial EUS-core sampling or a drug after an established sensitive GIST diagnosis.

concept.n2.ercp-versus-gallbladder-sourc.displayName: Duct clearance does not remove the gallbladder source
concept.n2.ercp-versus-gallbladder-sourc.learningObjective: Reassess the remaining gallbladder treatment indication after common-duct clearance in mild biliary pancreatitis.
concept.n2.ercp-versus-gallbladder-sourc.novelty: Tests which anatomical source remains after a successful intervention, rather than choosing ERCP for a documented duct stone or first selecting the cholecystectomy timing.

concept.n2.hpylori-antibody-after-valid-.displayName: Antibody results after a valid eradication test
concept.n2.hpylori-antibody-after-valid-.learningObjective: Do not use antibody serology to overturn an appropriately performed active-infection test of cure and trigger unnecessary repeat eradication.
concept.n2.hpylori-antibody-after-valid-.novelty: Tests the treatment consequence of conflicting test types after eradication, rather than selecting an initial infection test or arranging the test-of-cure washout.

concept.n2.malignant-polyp-local-versus-.displayName: A clear polypectomy site and regional oncologic risk
concept.n2.malignant-polyp-local-versus-.learningObjective: Distinguish clearance of the local invasive-polyp site from the regional oncologic question created by adverse invasive histology.
concept.n2.malignant-polyp-local-versus-.novelty: Tests why additional local sampling does not answer the regional treatment question after clear local excision, rather than detecting an adverse feature or an involved local margin.

concept.n2.fissure-sphincterotomy-contin.displayName: Continence history before irreversible sphincter division
concept.n2.fissure-sphincterotomy-contin.learningObjective: Reassess a proposed lateral internal sphincterotomy when baseline leakage and sphincter-injury history put the patient outside the represented low-continence-risk scenario.
concept.n2.fissure-sphincterotomy-contin.novelty: Tests whether prior function changes the suitability of a planned irreversible step, rather than choosing sphincterotomy in the existing explicitly low-risk medical-treatment-failure scenario.

concept.n2.solid-meal-manometry-provocat.displayName: Matching esophageal provocation to unexplained food symptoms
concept.n2.solid-meal-manometry-provocat.learningObjective: Select symptom-matched solid-meal manometry provocation when an adequate ordinary water-swallow series does not explain food-associated obstruction symptoms.
concept.n2.solid-meal-manometry-provocat.novelty: Tests a remaining symptom-provocation decision after adequate baseline acquisition, rather than repairing an incomplete study or classifying an established achalasia pattern.

concept.n2.coverage-recipient-bed-versus.displayName: Coverage when the recipient bed cannot support a graft
concept.n2.coverage-recipient-bed-versus.learningObjective: Choose a reconstructive approach that transfers perfused tissue when the recipient bed cannot support avascular skin transfer.
concept.n2.coverage-recipient-bed-versus.novelty: Applies the perfusion distinction to selecting wound coverage, rather than classifying a completed transfer by its vessels.

concept.n2.free-transfer-vascular-reconn.displayName: Perfusion after a completely detached tissue transfer
concept.n2.free-transfer-vascular-reconn.learningObjective: Identify the vascular reconnection needed by a completely detached vessel-bearing flap rather than apply graft or pedicled-flap assumptions.
concept.n2.free-transfer-vascular-reconn.novelty: Tests the operative perfusion step required after a fully detached transfer, rather than naming the transfer category or donor relationship.

concept.n2.operative-wound-class-versus-.displayName: Operative contamination and a later wound infection
concept.n2.operative-wound-class-versus-.learningObjective: Keep contamination class at the operation separate from a subsequent surgical-site infection when reconciling wound documentation.
concept.n2.operative-wound-class-versus-.novelty: Tests the temporal scope of two different wound descriptors, rather than assigning the operative class from a single intraoperative observation or treating a new SSI.

concept.n2.contrast-local-extravasation-.displayName: A local contrast event despite an allergy label
concept.n2.contrast-local-extravasation-.learningObjective: Distinguish a localized injection-site contrast event from a generalized allergic-like event using the actual distribution and timing.
concept.n2.contrast-local-extravasation-.novelty: Tests local tissue escape at the injection site, rather than the prior whole-body warmth versus urticaria distinction.

concept.n2.tacrolimus-antibody-pathway-b.displayName: T-cell suppression does not establish antibody-pathway control
concept.n2.tacrolimus-antibody-pathway-b.learningObjective: Do not use tacrolimus's T-cell target to exclude a separately supported preformed-antibody vascular mechanism in graft injury.
concept.n2.tacrolimus-antibody-pathway-b.novelty: Tests the mechanistic coverage limit of the drug in the presence of another immune pathway, rather than recalling its enzyme target or proving sample timing for a crossmatch.

concept.n2.ventral-hernia-priority-chang.displayName: Urgent findings override an elective optimization plan
concept.n2.ventral-hernia-priority-chang.learningObjective: Change an elective incisional-hernia optimization plan when acute irreducibility and obstructive/peritoneal findings develop.
concept.n2.ventral-hernia-priority-chang.novelty: Tests the priority switch after an established elective plan becomes unsafe, rather than identifying a modifiable elective risk in a stable reducible hernia.

concept.n2.irreversible-ischemia-revascu.displayName: Irreversible limb findings and the proposed intervention
concept.n2.irreversible-ischemia-revascu.learningObjective: Use a complete irreversible acute-ischemia examination to reject attempted revascularization and obtain vascular assessment of a non-salvage pathway.
concept.n2.irreversible-ischemia-revascu.novelty: Tests the intervention boundary after full viability findings, rather than naming a viability class or arranging emergency vascular transfer for an undifferentiated presentation.

concept.n2.negative-predictive-value-den.learningObjective: Calculate negative predictive value using everyone with a negative test rather than all reference-negative or all reference-positive participants.
concept.n2.negative-predictive-value-den.novelty: Tests the negative-result conditional probability, distinct from sensitivity/specificity and the existing positive-result prevalence task.

concept.n2.positive-likelihood-ratio.displayName: Comparing positive-result frequency across reference groups
concept.n2.positive-likelihood-ratio.learningObjective: Calculate a positive likelihood ratio as the positive-test probability with the condition divided by that probability without it.
concept.n2.positive-likelihood-ratio.novelty: Tests a diagnostic evidence ratio between reference groups, rather than a predictive probability, treatment risk ratio or conditional odds ratio.

concept.n2.number-needed-to-harm.displayName: Absolute adverse-event increase and number needed to harm
concept.n2.number-needed-to-harm.learningObjective: Calculate number needed to harm from an absolute adverse-event increase with the comparator and follow-up horizon retained.
concept.n2.number-needed-to-harm.novelty: Tests an adverse-event excess and its direction, rather than the existing beneficial-event reduction/NNT objective.

concept.n2.mcnemar-paired-binary-outcome.displayName: A paired binary change needs a paired analysis
concept.n2.mcnemar-paired-binary-outcome.learningObjective: Choose McNemar analysis for repeated binary observations in the same patients rather than treat the before and after groups as independent.
concept.n2.mcnemar-paired-binary-outcome.novelty: McNemar appears only as a wrong-category boundary in earlier claims; this is its first positive paired-binary decision target.

concept.n2.equivalence-margin-versus-nul.displayName: Equivalence requires the prespecified margin comparison
concept.n2.equivalence-margin-versus-nul.learningObjective: Use the protocol-specified equivalence interval rule rather than a nonsignificant zero-difference test to judge equivalence.
concept.n2.equivalence-margin-versus-nul.novelty: Tests a positive equivalence decision from a prespecified margin and the corresponding interval, rather than null-effect significance, precision or power.

concept.n2.case-mix-standardized-risk.displayName: Comparing outcomes at a common surgical case mix
concept.n2.case-mix-standardized-risk.learningObjective: Calculate directly standardized outcome risks using a common specified stratum distribution rather than compare crude rates from different case mixes.
concept.n2.case-mix-standardized-risk.novelty: Tests a quantitative common-case-mix comparison, rather than merely naming confounding or dividing crude risks.

concept.trauma-vka.emergency-reversal-sc.learningObjective: Recognize the documented VKA exposure and bleeding or urgent-intervention scope for this emergency teaching.

concept.trauma-vka.rapid-concentrated-pc.learningObjective: Identify the approved rapid, concentrated, lower-volume PCC comparison with plasma.

concept.trauma-vka.four-factor-pcc-compo.learningObjective: Identify the named procoagulant factors in the four-factor PCC teaching set.

before.Presentation: Jamie Taylor, a 57-year-old woman, visits the clinic because food and drinks pause behind the sternum and return at night. Endoscopy shows no fixed narrowing or intraluminal mass; the symptoms have persisted despite treatment directed at reflux.

Exhibit.caption: Constructed technically adequate pressure study; references are specific to this laboratory.

items.label: Primary supine series
items.value: Ten wet swallows; median relaxation pressure above the laboratory upper reference limit

items.label: Secondary upright series
items.value: Median relaxation pressure within the reference range

items.label: Esophageal body in both positions
items.value: Every swallow has DCI below 100 mmHg.s.cm; no premature or propagated distal contraction

before.Task: Which interpretation and planning decision should follow Jamie Taylor's study?
Options: **KEY:** Conclusive achalasia pattern; arrange junction-directed treatment assessment
Inconclusive outflow-obstruction pattern; obtain corroboration before treatment assessment
Absent-contractility pattern; arrange reflux-directed management assessment

after.Presentation: Jamie Taylor, a 57-year-old woman, visits the clinic because food and drinks pause behind the sternum and return at night. Endoscopy shows no fixed narrowing or intraluminal mass.

Exhibit.caption: Constructed technically adequate pressure study; references are specific to this laboratory.

after.Task: Which treatment should be offered to Jamie Taylor on the basis of this workup?

before: **KEY:** Conclusive achalasia pattern; arrange junction-directed treatment assessment
Complete failed peristalsis with abnormal primary-position relaxation pressure meets the classification despite a normal secondary-position pressure.
Inconclusive outflow-obstruction pattern; obtain corroboration before treatment assessment
Overapplies the both-position EGJOO requirement to a patient with no preserved peristalsis.
Absent-contractility pattern; arrange reflux-directed management assessment
Treats the normal upright measurement as overriding the abnormal adequate primary-position study.
after: **KEY:** Laparoscopic Heller myotomy
The adequate primary-position study establishes absent peristalsis with impaired junction relaxation. Myotomy is an established junction-directed treatment.
Oral omeprazole therapy
Reflux-directed acid suppression does not treat the demonstrated junction-relaxation and body-motility problem. A normal upright pressure does not erase the adequate primary-series findings.
Oral isosorbide dinitrate therapy

Pharmacological junction relaxation is a less effective palliative approach, rather than the preferred durable treatment for a routine procedural candidate. It can have a role when definitive options are unsuitable.

before: **KEY:** Single wet swallows after baseline recovery

This can assess emptying and corroborate obstruction, but does not supply the missing separated-swallow body classification.
Obtain ambulatory esophageal pH-impedance monitoring
Reflux monitoring answers a different remaining question and does not replace the missing baseline motility acquisition.

after.Task: Which paired interpretation best fits Jamie Taylor’s displayed recordings?

Preserved contraction reserve with impaired liquid-load outflow
Reduced contraction reserve with impaired liquid-load outflow

before: **KEY:** Revise the reserve conclusion; retain the outflow conclusion

Normal inhibition during the sequence is not evidence of post-sequence augmentation. The repeat responses challenge the reserve conclusion, whereas reproduced discomfort without the supplied outflow findings does not establish liquid-load obstruction.
Retain the reserve conclusion; revise the outflow conclusion
This accepts suppression as proof of reserve and lets symptom reproduction override the actual junction and pressure observations during loading.
Revise the reserve conclusion; revise the outflow conclusion
The reserve conclusion needs correction, but the symptom-provoking liquid load does not itself supply evidence for the added outflow revision.
Retain the reserve conclusion; retain the outflow conclusion
Baseline propagation and appropriate inhibition do not establish the post-sequence reserve response. Accepting the whole draft misses that distinction.
after: **KEY:** Reduced contraction reserve with preserved liquid-load outflow

Lack of post-sequence augmentation on both repeats indicates reduced reserve; symptoms during drinking do not by themselves establish outflow obstruction when the pressure observations remain reassuring.
Preserved contraction reserve with impaired liquid-load outflow
This treats inhibition during swallowing as evidence of post-swallow reserve and treats symptom reproduction as proof of outflow obstruction.
Reduced contraction reserve with impaired liquid-load outflow
This recognizes the reserve finding but overinterprets the familiar symptom despite the actual liquid-load pressure response.
Preserved contraction reserve with preserved liquid-load outflow
This correctly limits the outflow conclusion but confuses inhibition during the sequence with augmentation afterwards.

The report diagnoses a nevus in the submitted fragment. Serial photographs show enlargement of the medial focus while the pale lateral border has the same outline. Completion sampling is being arranged with the existing slides available for review.

Reassess the existing fragment with additional tissue levels

after.Presentation: Jamie Taylor, a 67-year-old woman, visits the clinic with a changing pigmented lesion on the upper arm. The lesion has an irregular border with darker and lighter areas. On examination, the surrounding lax skin can be brought together around the entire lesion without tension.
after.Current update: A punch from the pale lateral edge contains a nevus. The darker medial portion remains in place and has enlarged on serial photographs.
after.Task: Which next diagnostic step should be arranged for Jamie Taylor’s remaining lesion?
Options: Perform a punch biopsy of the darker portion
Request deeper histological sections from the block

before: **KEY:** Correlate the submitted site with the procedure photograph

The central label and photographed punch location do not assign the benign tissue to the same clinical target. Resolve that provenance before treating the benign diagnosis as concordant with the changing focus.
Reassess the existing fragment with additional tissue levels
Deeper levels can answer a question about tissue in the block, but they cannot establish that it came from the changing center when the location records disagree.
Reassess the existing fragment with additional immunostains
Ancillary stains can contribute to classification, but they do not settle which clinical sector was represented. The benign fragment need not be erroneous to leave the changing focus unexplained.
after: **KEY:** Perform a narrow-margin excisional biopsy
Complete narrow-margin diagnostic sampling can evaluate the residual changing lesion’s architecture and invasion when the small accessible site permits it.
Perform a punch biopsy of the darker portion
This targets the unrepresented focus but may still leave lesion architecture or maximum depth unresolved when complete diagnostic excision is feasible.
Request deeper histological sections from the block
Further sections of the pale-edge fragment cannot represent the still-unsampled changing medial tissue.

packet.keyOrderNotice: key shown first for review only; runtime options are randomized

before.Task: Which hormonal screen should Jamie Taylor receive?

after.Presentation: Jamie Taylor, a 44-year-old woman, attends the clinic after CT performed for an unrelated complaint shows a 2.3-cm adrenal nodule.
after.Task: Which study should be used to assess cortisol secretion in Jamie Taylor’s adrenal evaluation?

before: **KEY:** Overnight dexamethasone test
Plasma-free metanephrines
Aldosterone-renin ratio
Late-night salivary cortisol
after: **KEY:** 1-mg overnight dexamethasone test
The incidentaloma guideline recommends this test for autonomous cortisol secretion in the routine adult setting. It is one component of assessment, not the entire adrenal workup.
Late-night salivary cortisol measurement
This is a cortisol test used in other hypercortisolism evaluations, but it is not the preferred offered screen for the incidentaloma scenario.
Urinary free cortisol measurement
Urinary cortisol evaluation can address other hypercortisolism questions; the offered incidentaloma-specific screen is the overnight dexamethasone test.
